physical_samples.seed_sequence: SeedSequence([42, hazard_index, split_code, realization_index]); hazard_index follows hazards_in_seed_order; planning=0, evaluation=1
physical_samples.damage: one ordered DS0-DS4 vector per physical sample from retained July PGA/fragility
physical_samples.duration: one strictly positive July DS-specific draw per DS>0 task; DS0 duration=0
physical_samples.canonical_hash: SHA256(newline-terminated ordered IDs || little-endian int64 DS || little-endian float64 duration)

production.crews: C57 pooled regional resource, 57 crews at frozen active origins
production.travel: retained directed base-to-task and task-to-task matrices; no fallback
production.task_and_clock: DS>0 tasks; arrival=crew_available+directed travel; completion=arrival+realized duration; crew release and raw restoration at completion
production.interpretation: source-connected availability proxy, not delivered power

GA.stopping: fixed generation budget for all seeds
GA.chromosome: full permutation of the retained 92 IDs
GA.objective_maximize: negative mean population-times-resolved-mass cumulative community burden over the 64 planning realizations
GA.evaluation_chain: DS>0 filter -> event crew schedule -> completion functionality -> production source gate -> production mapping -> event-integrated tract burden
GA.deterministic_incumbents: all seven rule sequences evaluated with the same objective and planning samples
GA.candidate_rule: highest final retained fitness among five seeds; exact tie smallest seed; retain incumbent if search does not improve it
GA.planning_horizon_rule: pre-search fixed H_plan=max(480, maximum across planning samples of [sum positive task durations + task_count*largest finite directed travel cell]); independent of evaluation and candidate result

strategies.unconstrained_reference: unconstrained recovery with same DS/duration and source gate, no crew competition
strategies.direct_community: one ex-ante sequence frozen from 2pc50 planning and applied to all four hazards; report incumbent identity if equal
strategies.filter_rule: remove DS0 from full fixed priority sequence; no re-ranking
strategies.baseline_count_basis: 4 hazards*1000 physical samples*(1 unconstrained+8 scheduled); only 4000 independent evaluation damage draws

resource_sensitivity.design: one factor at a time; no crew-duration Cartesian product
resource_sensitivity.crew_rounding: existing _scale_sensitivity_crew_origins: floor(57*scale+0.5), proportional depot allocation by stable largest remainder
resource_sensitivity.duration_rule: multiply same saved positive durations; DS0 stays zero; never redraw
resource_sensitivity.strategies: same eight scheduled strategies; reuse baseline run at 1.0/1.0
resource_sensitivity.additional_count_basis: 1000 paired samples*8 strategies*(3 nonbaseline crew+3 nonbaseline duration cases)

offline_robustness.M3_domain: 337 comparable SCE tracts; 17 unresolved native rows and common positive-mass 320 separately
offline_robustness.mapping_gate_grid: all seven mappings x four gates for 2pc50/C57 only, on fixed saved station states

loss_and_topology.tract: apply M1 to each additive loss and integrate at exact events; do not decompose T50/T80 additively
focus: tracts with source loss greater than local damage loss

horizon.planning: fixed H_plan from planning inputs only, as specified under GA
horizon.evaluation: after all scheduled completions are known but before service integration, one H_eval=max(480, ceil(max completion across all hazards, samples, eight strategies and OFAT resource cases)); same horizon for every evaluation comparison

metrics.missing: zero resolved mass -> unresolved/NA; never zero burden or restored service
metrics.paired_uncertainty: realization-level paired differences; 10000 percentile bootstrap resamples, seed42; mean/median/direction fraction/95% interval

stage_7: rerun original vulnerability/built-environment/risk/service/grid PCA/K-means/hotspot descriptives on formal 1000-sample results; zero-variance feature excluded and logged only if still constant; not causal
fail_fast: paired comparison requires exact physical and context identity; no resampling or parameter adjustment following results
execution_order_after_freeze_commit: schedule all evaluation and OFAT resource cases
evaluate production states and tract outcomes
pre_run_code_alignment_required: formal config must set 1000 evaluation, 64 planning and five GA seeds instead of trial values
planning samples only for 2pc50, not each hazard
fixed planning/common evaluation horizon rather than 480-hour rejection
formal archive identity and status instead of TRIAL_NOT_FINAL
OFAT resource cases through revised event scheduler rather than legacy mean-duration sensitivity
